stories.title: Knicks Banner Night Is Two Days Away — What to Watch at MSG

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Text Post A (Posting Window: 7:00 PM ET)**
48 hours.

The Knicks raise their first championship banner since 1973.

LeBron walks into MSG wearing a 76ers jersey.

Jalen Brunson's house. His ring. His night. 🏀🔥

#HoopHeroes #Knicks #OpeningNight

facebook.long_form:
Two days from now, Madison Square Garden is going to be something else.

The New York Knicks raise their first championship banner since 1973 on Tuesday night. Jalen Brunson, Karl-Anthony Towns, Josh Hart, OG Anunoby, and Mikal Bridges — the same five guys who finished off the Spurs in June — walk out for Opening Night in front of the loudest building in the NBA.

Then LeBron James walks out wearing a Philadelphia 76ers jersey. For the first time since he landed in Philly, he plays a real game — and it happens to be at MSG, against the defending champions, on banner night. Jaylen Brown is right there with him.

The ceremony starts at 6:30 PM ET. Adam Silver hands out rings. The banner goes up. And then this Sixers team, built around LeBron and Brown, has to go play one of the best teams in the league on the road with 20,000 people screaming at them from tip-off.

Catch it Tuesday at 7 PM ET on NBC and Peacock. This one's going to be worth it.

---
facebook.image_caption:
Banner Night is almost here.

53 years in the making — Tuesday night at MSG, the Knicks raise the championship flag. Who's watching?

stories.title: Chet Holmgren's Opening Night Status in Doubt — Thunder's Star May Miss Game 1

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
**Text Post A (Posting Window: 4:00 PM ET)**
No Chet. No Oweh.

The Thunder could open the season without BOTH of them.

Holmgren (quad) hasn't played a preseason minute. Official status drops Oct. 19 at 5 PM ET.

SGA better be ready to carry. 👀

#HoopHeroes #Thunder #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The Thunder-Spurs West Finals rematch is two days away, and Oklahoma City still doesn't know if Chet Holmgren will be on the floor.

Holmgren has sat out every preseason game with a quad contusion. Head coach Mark Daigneault addressed his status Saturday, saying, "I'll leave that to the injury report. We'll report at 5 p.m. on the day before the first game." That means fans won't have a definitive answer until Monday evening at the earliest.

It's already a tough situation. Otega Oweh is gone for the year with an Achilles tear — a real loss for Oklahoma City's wing depth. If Holmgren joins him on the sideline for Opening Night, the Thunder face the Spurs and Victor Wembanyama without two key players in a game that was supposed to be the marquee matchup of the night.

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will play. He always does. But there's a big difference between SGA with a healthy Holmgren at his side and SGA trying to carry the team against a Spurs squad that's been healthy all preseason.

The injury report drops tomorrow at 5 PM ET. Stay tuned.

---
facebook.image_caption:
Will Chet play Tuesday? The Thunder don't know yet — and neither do we.

Injury report lands tomorrow at 5 PM ET. This one changes the whole Opening Night picture.

stories.title: Nuggets Lose Julian Strawther for Six Weeks — MRI Confirms Knee Sprain

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
**Text Post A (Posting Window: 9:00 AM ET)**
MRI results are in.

Julian Strawther: left knee sprain. OUT at least 6 weeks.

Gone until around Thanksgiving. The Nuggets open the season shorthanded. 🤕

#HoopHeroes #Nuggets #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The MRI results are in, and they're not what Denver wanted to hear.

Julian Strawther suffered a left knee sprain during the third quarter of Colorado's preseason loss to the Clippers on October 14. The good news: no structural damage, no torn ligament. The bad news: he's out at least six weeks, which means the Nuggets won't have him back until around Thanksgiving.

Strawther had developed into a reliable perimeter shooter and rotational piece for Denver over the past two seasons. Losing him for the first five-plus weeks of the schedule forces head coach David Adelman to lean harder on Christian Braun and Peyton Watson for wing minutes while also navigating depth questions throughout the rotation.

There's also a business angle to this. Strawther was eligible for a rookie contract extension through October 19. It's unclear whether that deal got done before the injury news became official.

The Nuggets are still one of the West's top teams. But they're opening the year without a piece they were counting on — and in this league, roster depth gets tested early.

---
facebook.image_caption:
Six weeks. That's the Strawther timeline.

MRI confirmed a left knee sprain — no structural damage, but Denver is without him until Thanksgiving. Tough way to start the year.

stories.title: Knicks Cut Bruce Brown, Keep Wiseman — Defending Champs Lock In Roster

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
**Text Post A (Posting Window: 11:00 AM ET)**
Bruce Brown is OUT. James Wiseman is IN.

Knicks made their final roster call Saturday. Second apron math made the decision for them. 💸

The defending champs set their 15. Opening Night Tuesday. 🏆

#HoopHeroes #Knicks #NBA

facebook.long_form:
The Knicks made their last roster decision Saturday, and it came down to one thing: the second apron.

New York waived Bruce Brown to keep James Wiseman. Brown had played all 82 games for the Denver Nuggets last season before signing with the Knicks in camp. Wiseman won the final center spot on the roster, giving New York three big men heading into a title defense.

Head coach Tom Thibodeau and the front office reportedly felt that carrying both Brown (a wing) and Wiseman (a center) in the salary structure exceeded the second apron threshold that owner James Dolan has been committed to staying under. The math won.

Brown could potentially return if the Knicks make a trade that reshuffles their cap situation. In the meantime, Pacome Dadiet and Miles Kolek are the remaining wings behind the starting five.

The full Knicks roster is set. Tuesday's ring ceremony and banner raising at MSG is officially two days away.

---

stories.title: Clippers Opening Night Roster Confirmed — Ingram, Beal, Strus, Konan Out

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
**Text Post A (Posting Window: 1:00 PM ET)**
Tyronn Lue confirmed it: four Clippers out for the Oct. 21 opener.

Ingram. Beal (knee). Strus. Konan Niederhauser.

Cameron Christie and Babi Miller are picking up the slack. 😬

#HoopHeroes #Clippers #NBA

facebook.long_form:
Tyronn Lue made it official: the Clippers are opening the season without four rotation players.

Out for the October 21 game against the Sacramento Kings: Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal (knee inflammation, no timeline), Max Strus, and rookie Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot injury). That's a significant portion of the rotation gone before the first real game of the year.

Cameron Christie, who played on a two-way contract, is going to get meaningful run. Babi Miller is expected to start at center. Lue and his staff are going to have to get creative with a shorter-than-expected lineup in game one.

The most concerning name on that list is Beal. Knee inflammation with no timeline means there's no certainty on when — or if — he comes back healthy for a sustained stretch this year. Los Angeles signed Beal this summer expecting a major contributor. This is not the start they were hoping for.

The Kings, on the other hand, just got the best possible draw for a season opener.

---
facebook.image_caption:
Four Clippers out for the season opener. Ingram. Beal. Strus. Konan.

Sacramento is going to be very happy to see that injury report.
